generators.name: seeded active-site mutation
generators.description: Guarantee one non-identity substitution within the registered enzyme active site.

evidence.quote: Every proposal changes exactly one registered active-site residue.

constraints.name: MPNN sequence probability
constraints.description: Minimize LigandMPNN probability loss for active-site substitutions.

evidence.quote: The LigandMPNN objective is its existing probability loss, `1 - pMPNN`, in `[0, 1]`.

constraints.name: ESMFold confidence objective
constraints.description: Minimize exact ESMFold confidence energy without retaining an unused structure side output.

evidence.quote: The ESMFold adapter is score-only: it runs the ordinary ESMFold parent, preserves the exact scalar pLDDT energy, and discards only the predicted structure and PDB text because no downstream step consumes them.

constraints.name: protein length range
constraints.description: Keep enzyme length fixed to the holo structure.

evidence.quote: The enzyme sequence remains fixed at the chain-A length registered from holo structure 3HTB, and only the registered active-site positions may mutate.

optimizers.name: MCMC refinement
optimizers.description: Region-local LigandMPNN mutations within the active site.

evidence.quote: Development smoke: five MCMC steps with one guaranteed active-site substitution per step.

model_dependencies.name: LigandMPNN
model_dependencies.purpose: Ligand-aware inverse folding and scoring in the active site

steps.operation: weighted joint MCMC accept or reject

assumptions: Carbonic anhydrase II holo structure PDB 3HTB chain A is a compact ligand-aware benchmark.
Active-site positions are 1-indexed ordinals on chain A suitable for LigandMPNN ResidueSelection.
Metal3d scoring is omitted when the benchmark structure lacks a modeled metal cofactor.
pLDDT 70 is a reporting target, not a hard optimizer threshold.
The score-only ESMFold adapter is valid here because no downstream step consumes its structure.
unknowns: Catalytic turnover and ligand affinity are not modeled.
Boltz-2 affinity scoring is deferred to keep smoke tier latency manageable.
The first portable surrogate uses amino-acid composition features and may defer position-specific mutations.
